ABOUT.INTRO_TITLE: A Trusted Name in Dairy & Juice
ABOUT.INTRO_P1: Halima is a leading Egyptian manufacturer of premium milk and fruit juice products, serving households, retailers, and hospitality partners across the nation. Built on decades of expertise, we combine traditional care with modern food science to deliver freshness families can rely on.
ABOUT.INTRO_P2: From our state-of-the-art facility in Cairo's industrial zone, we oversee every step — sourcing, processing, packaging, and distribution — ensuring that the Halima name stands for purity, nutrition, and consistent taste in every product.
ABOUT.VISION_TEXT: To be the most trusted dairy and juice brand in the Middle East and North Africa — recognized for uncompromising quality, nutritional excellence, and a positive impact on the communities we serve.
ABOUT.VISION_QUOTE: Leading with freshness, growing with purpose.

FAQ.META_KEYWORDS: Halima FAQ, dairy questions, juice FAQ, milk storage, product quality
FAQ.HERO_SUBTITLE: Everything you need to know about Halima products and services.
FAQ.EMPTY: No questions found in this category.
FAQ.CTA_TEXT: Our customer support team is ready to help with product details, orders, partnerships, and quality concerns.

Q1.QUESTION: What types of milk products does Halima offer?
Q1.ANSWER: Halima offers a full range of dairy products including fresh full-cream milk, low-fat milk, flavored milk, and long-life UHT milk — all produced from carefully sourced milk and packaged for everyday family use.

Q2.QUESTION: Is Halima milk suitable for children and families?
Q2.ANSWER: Yes. Halima milk is pasteurized and produced to meet strict food safety standards. It provides essential calcium and protein, making it a wholesome choice for children and adults when consumed as part of a balanced diet.

Q3.QUESTION: Is Halima milk pasteurized and homogenized?
Q3.ANSWER: All Halima fresh milk undergoes pasteurization to eliminate harmful bacteria and homogenization for a smooth, consistent texture. UHT variants are ultra-heat treated for extended shelf life without compromising safety.

Q4.QUESTION: What flavors of juice does Halima produce?
Q4.ANSWER: Our juice line includes popular flavors such as orange, mango, mixed fruit, apple, guava, and pineapple. Each variety is crafted from quality fruit concentrates and natural flavors to deliver a refreshing taste.

Q5.QUESTION: Do Halima juices contain added sugar?
Q5.ANSWER: Some Halima juice varieties contain added sugar to balance natural fruit acidity and enhance taste. Full ingredient and nutritional information is printed on every package so you can make informed choices for your family.

Q6.QUESTION: Are Halima juices suitable for daily consumption?
Q6.ANSWER: Halima juices can be enjoyed as part of a balanced diet. They provide vitamins and hydration, though we recommend moderate consumption and pairing them with whole fruits, vegetables, and dairy for optimal nutrition.

Q7.QUESTION: What quality certifications does Halima hold?
Q7.ANSWER: Halima operates under internationally recognized food safety management systems including ISO 22000 and HACCP protocols. Our facility is regularly audited to ensure compliance with Egyptian and international standards.

Q8.QUESTION: How does Halima test products before release?
Q8.ANSWER: Every production batch undergoes laboratory testing for microbiological safety, sensory quality, and packaging integrity. Products are released only after passing our internal quality checkpoints and documented batch approval process.

Q9.QUESTION: Do your products contain artificial preservatives?
Q9.ANSWER: We prioritize natural ingredients and use preservatives only when necessary to maintain freshness and safety, always within approved regulatory limits. Full ingredient lists are available on all product labels.

Q10.QUESTION: How should I store Halima milk after opening?
Q10.ANSWER: Once opened, refrigerate Halima milk immediately at 2–6°C. Keep the carton tightly closed, consume within 3–4 days, and never leave it at room temperature for extended periods.

Q11.QUESTION: How should I store unopened and opened Halima juice?
Q11.ANSWER: Store unopened juice in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight until the best-before date. After opening, refrigerate at 2–6°C and consume within 3–5 days for best taste and freshness.

Q12.QUESTION: Where can I buy Halima products in Egypt?
Q12.ANSWER: Halima products are available at major supermarket chains, neighborhood grocery stores, and selected wholesalers across Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, and other governorates. Contact us for the nearest distributor in your area.

Q13.QUESTION: Can I become a Halima distributor?
Q13.ANSWER: Yes! We welcome partnership inquiries from retailers, wholesalers, and food service businesses. Visit our Contact page with your business details and our sales team will respond within 2–3 business days.

Q14.QUESTION: How can I report a product quality concern?
Q14.ANSWER: Your satisfaction matters. Contact us by phone or email with the product name, batch number, purchase date, and a brief description of the issue. Our quality team investigates every report and responds promptly.

Q15.QUESTION: What are Halima's customer support hours and contact methods?
Q15.ANSWER: Our support team is available Sunday through Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Cairo time). Reach us by phone at +20 100 000 0000, email at info@halima.com, or through the contact form on our website.
